mapper.select: SELECT id, monitor_point_code, `value`, monitor_time, date_type, `max_value`, min_value, avg_value FROM ( SELECT *, -- 仅对“实时数据”按监控点分组排序 ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY monitor_point_code ORDER BY monitor_time DESC ) AS rn FROM environment_value WHERE date_type = 'real_time' -- 提前过滤，减少计算量 ) AS subquery WHERE rn = 1; -- 取每组最新记录

SELECT level_type AS 'level', COUNT(*) AS 'count' FROM ( SELECT value, CASE WHEN value > 0 AND value <= 35 THEN '优' WHEN value > 35 AND value <= 75 THEN '良' WHEN value > 75 AND value <= 115 THEN '轻度污染' WHEN value > 115 AND value <= 150 THEN '中度污染' WHEN value > 150 AND value <= 250 THEN '重度污染' WHEN value > 250 THEN '严重污染' ELSE '数据异常' END AS level_type FROM environment_value WHERE monitor_point_code = 'pm25' AND value IS NOT NULL
AND monitor_time >= DATE_SUB('2025-09-28 00:00:00', INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND monitor_time <= '2025-09-28 00:00:00' AND date_type = 'day_time' ) AS level_data GROUP BY level_type ORDER BY CASE level_type WHEN '优' THEN 1 WHEN '良' THEN 2 WHEN '轻度污染' THEN 3 WHEN '中度污染' THEN 4 WHEN '重度污染' THEN 5 WHEN '严重污染' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END;
